## Summary

Describe the change and why it belongs in tynt.

## Cartridge checklist

- [ ] The cartridge runs in the current tynt editor.
- [ ] Its title, author, description, and controls are complete.
- [ ] Its slug uses lowercase letters, numbers, and single hyphens.
- [ ] `cover.png` is an accurate 160 × 144 game capture.
- [ ] I created the source and artwork or may distribute them under the declared license.
- [ ] The cartridge does not import modules or attempt network access.
- [ ] `bun run check` passes locally.
